grammar_focus: KS9+KS33 介词 at/in/off/with 综合复习(at 某一点、in 之内/穿着、off 离开脱落、with 带有拿着)(教材 L57 Key structures)主考;SD make/let sb do(不带 to 不定式)+ 课文 the way + 从句、into、be eager to do(辅考)。素材=Aaron 净化生产包(2026-07-05,原课文过滤误判已核无害);unit_no=8(课程 U8 首课,L57-64)
scene: 一个穿牛仔裤的女人站在一家高档商店的橱窗前,看着一条连衣裙。她犹豫了一下,然后走进去要求看看。店员不喜欢她的穿着,轻蔑地瞥了她一眼,说那条裙子卖掉了。女人气冲冲地走了,决定第二天惩罚他。第二天早上她穿着皮草大衣回来,一手拿着钱包,一手拿着长伞。这次店员没认出她,急切地想为她服务。他爬进橱窗,把裙子从展台上取下来。她一看见就说不喜欢。她让店员把橱窗里几乎所有东西一件接一件都拿来。然后,她微笑着,最终买下了她第一次要看的那条裙子。

grammar_card.title: 介词 at / in / off / with
grammar_card.intro: KS9+KS33 综合复习介词:at 表'在某一点'(at the window、at the door、glance at);in 表'在…之内'或'穿着'(in jeans、in a fur coat、in the store);off 表'离开、脱落'(walk off、take off、off the shelf);with 表'带有、拿着'(with a purse、with a smile)。

rows: at the window / glanced at her
a woman in jeans / in a fur coat
walked off / take the dress off
with a purse in one hand

specialRules.rule: SD Make and Let:make sb do、let sb do 后接不带 to 的动词原形(made the clerk bring、let her try)。
the way + 从句表'…的方式'(the way she was dressed = 她穿着打扮的样子);介词 into 表'进入…里面'(climbed into the window)。

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — Did the woman get what she wanted?
options: Yes — after teasing the clerk, she bought the very dress she first asked for
No, the dress was really sold
She bought a fur coat instead

passage: A woman in jeans stood at the window of an expensive store, looking at a dress. She hesitated for a moment, then walked in and asked to see it. The salesclerk didn't like the way she was dressed. Glancing at her scornfully, he said the dress was sold. The woman walked off angrily and decided to punish him the next day. The next morning she came back in a fur coat, with a purse in one hand and a long umbrella in the other. This time the clerk didn't recognize her and was eager to serve her. He climbed into the window to take the dress off the display. As soon as she saw it, she said she didn't like it. She made the clerk bring almost everything in the window, one thing after another. Then, with a smile, she finally bought the very dress she had asked for the first time.
